senses.gloss:
Yuvati is the ordinary expression for a ‘young woman’ or ‘maiden’ in the Rigveda and later.
Foot notes i. 118, 5; ii. 35, 4; iii. 54, 14; iv. 18, 8; v. 2, 1. 2; ix. 86, 16; x. 30, 5.
